stations.title: What's on page
stations.note: Alder cannot see where Tab is.

captions: The cards fit any screen. Next, Priya presses Evening mode on a night shift.
Nothing changes, and Alder on the keyboard cannot see where the focus is.
You give the page its evening colours and a visible focus, in three tasks.
Now Evening mode dims the page and says whether it is on.
Calm at night, clear on the keyboard. The page holds up for everyone.
